phase_1_bench_validation.objective: Physical bench test: damper vs ASD vs standard, 4 postural pressures (10/20/30/40 mmHg), 10 runs each, blinded analysis. Endpoints: response_time_damper_ms, proportional_error_pct.
phase_1_bench_validation.pass_criteria: Both endpoints: 95% CI entirely below pass threshold (200ms, 15%)

phase_2_prototype.objective: Build functional prototype incorporating bench-validated mechanism

phase_3_relevant_environment.objective: Test in clinically relevant environment (cadaver, animal, or simulated)
